0022600017.text: The Brooklyn Nets (0-4, on a four-game losing streak and 15th in the East) host the Detroit Pistons (4-1, first in the East and in the Central) in the Emirates NBA Cup East Group A game, the fifth of the season for Brooklyn. Brooklyn is without Egor Demin (leg bruise) and Tyler Bilodeau (shoulder sprain), both out, and Noah Clowney is day-to-day with an illness and is a game-time decision, while Detroit is missing Isaiah Joe (hip bruise) and Jalen Duren (hamstring strain), both out. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, though Brooklyn lost the 2025-26 series 1-3, including a 138-100 defeat to Detroit in Brooklyn on March 10, 2026, the last meeting between them.
